caption: The drawing depicts a textile pattern with a symmetrical and repeating design. The composition consists of stylized foliage, floral shapes, and geometric elements arranged vertically and horizontally across the textile. The primary colors used are a muted red, which forms the background and interstitial spaces, and a pale green, which is used for the detailed patterns of leaves, flowers, and abstract shapes. The edges of the textile are bordered by the same pattern and the bottom edge has a fringe of red threads. The pattern includes large central motifs resembling bouquets of leaves, flanked by smaller leafy and floral elements, and the design is consistent throughout the fabric. The background surrounding the textile is beige.
title: Ingrain Carpet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
